boundary: scripts/python/run_aee.py version enforcement, extension.yml requires, README requirements table

evidence.description: Before: _AEE_VERSION_MIN = (1, 4, 0) and REQUIRED_AEE_VERSION = ">=1.4.0,<2"; the enforcement machinery (clean exit-2 refusal naming versions) already exists from the RT3 remediation.

falsification_tests: Run the runner against a stub aee reporting version 1.4.0 and observe it start instead of refusing, or find the floor declared as >=1.4.0 in any of the three places after this change.
claims.text: The extension's engine floor names the realigned engine: the runner refuses an engine below the floor at startup with exit 2 naming the found and required versions, and extension.yml plus the README declare the same range.

evidence.description: Before: the assess JSON reports paths, extension_version, ledger_verification, latest_pointer, aee_exit_code, timed_out, ok - no verdict content at all; the vocabulary lives only inside the assessment file.

falsification_tests: Run runner assess on a bundle with a stage-capped claim and observe the runner JSON omit reported_statuses, lanes, or not_understood, or show values differing from the assessment file it produced.
claims.text: The runner's assess JSON displays the realigned verdict vocabulary - outcome, methodology_version, stage-capped reported_statuses, stage_caps, the lane pair, and not_understood - copied from the stamped assessment it produced, identical to what the bare CLI reports on the same bundle.

evidence.description: Before: the claim vocabulary lists no stage field and no exposition kind; the reporting paragraph asks for outcome and verdict counts with no lanes, no reported-status rule, and no not_understood.

falsification_tests: Read the two command files after this change and find no stage vocabulary, no exposition kind, or reporting instructions that present author-declared statuses or a lane-1 outcome as settled.
claims.text: The assess and gate command documents teach the realigned vocabulary: stage values and headline/role on claims, exposition as an evidence kind, reported (stage-capped) statuses in reporting, the two lanes reported as a pair, not_understood rendered with every verdict, unjudged distinct from abstained, and the gate described as a lane-1 checking decision.

boundary: runner assess end-to-end against the joint engine on PATH

evidence.description: The Spec 004 plan's P5 acceptance criterion, restated for this repo.

falsification_tests: Run both paths on the same bundle and diff the displayed caps, lanes, and not_understood: any divergence falsifies this claim.
claims.text: Acceptance: an assessment produced through the extension on a bundle with stage caps and residual unknowns displays the same caps, lanes, and not_understood as the bare engine CLI produces on the same bundle.
